_agent_clients: MCP clients whose calls can come from agents. Other clients (for example a commit hook calling the guard layer) and calls with no recorded client are not counted, and the report lists them.
_instance_source: The unit is an agent instance: one agent context, such as a subagent. For this client a call is tied to an instance by its client_call_id (Claude Code's params._meta["claudecode/toolUseId"]): the instance is the one Claude Code transcript file, a main conversation or a subagent, that holds that id as a tool_use id. An id found in no transcript, or in more than one, maps to no instance and is counted, not guessed.
_about: Declared guard set for Incident-Driven Guard Coverage. Each guard's version and version_at are used to restart item-4 windows. regression_test maps every pattern the guard covers to the first commit at which both the guard and a regression test replaying the observed action through this entry point are in place, or to null when no such test exists yet.
